question: Should an OpenClaw maintainer accept LanceDB `existOk` as the bundled plugin’s cross-process initialization boundary and clear the human-review pause for the refreshed exact head?
rationale: The implementation and proof are strong, but protected labels and the prior review explicitly reserve final acceptance of the storage-concurrency boundary for an independent maintainer.

options.title: Approve refreshed exact head
options.body: Refresh against current main and merge if the patch remains identical and all required checks pass.

options.title: Require remote-storage proof
options.body: Keep the pause until concurrent initialization is demonstrated against a supported non-local storage URI.

options.title: Pause this approach
options.body: Keep the PR open or close it if maintainers do not want LanceDB’s native create semantics to define this plugin boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve refreshed exact head
recommendation.body: Refresh against current main and merge if the patch remains identical and all required checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal connects this person to recent memory-lancedb review, release snapshots, and repository-level plugin direction.
